entities.name: Lucrezia Buti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucrezia Buti was an Italian nun who later became the lover of the painter Fra Filippo Lippi and the mother of his children. She is believed to be the model for several Madonnas portrayed in Lippi's paintings.
